kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
حببت (form I)
# حَبَبْتُ (ḥababtu) /ħa.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# حَبَبْتَ (ḥababta) /ħa.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# حَبَبْتِ (ḥababti) /ħa.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of حَبَّ (ḥabba)
# حُبِبْتُ (ḥubibtu) /ħu.bib.tu/: first-person singular past passive of حَبَّ (ḥabba) and حُبَّ (ḥubba)
# حُبِ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
